recipeNotes: A socket.io collaboration server with exactly one HTTP route, so the representative workload is the socket protocol: two concurrent clients exercising every server-side handler (join-room in both the first-in-room and new-user branches, server-broadcast, server-volatile-broadcast, user-follow/unfollow, disconnecting). Driven over the raw engine.io websocket protocol because the repo ships no socket client.

phases.name: common
phases.detail: the complete express surface: the single route, static public/, and a 404

phases.name: full
phases.detail: two concurrent socket.io clients driving every server-side event handler

command.cmd: /Users/sara/.asdf/installs/nodejs/24.19.0/bin/node -e 'const U="ws://127.0.0.1:3411/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket";const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const mk=(n)=>new Promise((res)=>{const ws=new WebSocket(U);ws.sid=null;ws.onmessage=(e)=>{const d=String(e.data);if(d[0]==="0"){ws.send("40");}else if(d.startsWith("40")){ws.sid=JSON.parse(d.slice(2)).sid;console.log(n,"connected");res(ws);}else if(d==="2"){ws.send("3");}else if(d.startsWith("42")){console.log(n,"<-",d.slice(2,120));}};});(async()=>{const a=await mk("A"),b=await mk("B");a.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["join-room","reducer-room"]));await sleep(300);b.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["join-room","reducer-room"]));await sleep(300);a.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["server-broadcast","reducer-room",[1,2,3,4],[9,9]]));a.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["server-volatile-broadcast","reducer-room",[5,6],[1]]));await sleep(300);b.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["user-follow",{userToFollow:{socketId:a.sid,username:"A"},action:"FOLLOW"}]));await sleep(300);b.send("42"+JSON.stringify(["user-follow",{userToFollow:{socketId:a.sid,username:"A"},action:"UNFOLLOW"}]));await sleep(300);b.close();await sleep(400);a.close();await sleep(600);process.exit(0);})();'
